evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3660350 ($236.28, product C, online) scores 0.01 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.19.
Card baseline from 708 earlier transactions: median $59.08, 95th percentile $390.06; the flagged amount is 4.0x the median.
Card testing: 4 online authorizations under $5 within an hour ($1.53, $3.46, $3.33, $1.78), followed by 1 larger purchase(s) up to $236.28.

Cardholder C09582 reported the $236.28 charge as not theirs (case pack trigger, 2017-01-14 15:57:30). Measured on October: all 1,203 disputes the bank investigated were fraud, 15% of them scored under 0.05, so a low score does not clear a denial (0.99). If this is a planted dispute on a legitimate transaction, a score this size is 0.28x as likely on disputed fraud as on a legitimate transaction (0.22). Weighted equally: 0.84.
Card testing: three or more tiny online authorizations, often under $5, then a larger purchase. Confirmed by the sequence itself.
Policy R2: Customer denies the transaction: BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.

case.summary: Card testing on card C09582-K1: 5 transaction(s) from 2017-01-14 to 2017-01-14 totalling $246.38, probability 0.91.
